description: Storm tide Queensland series is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment, Tourism, Science and Innovation. Storm Tide Inundation Area (including projected climate change impacts to 2100). Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Environment, Tourism, Science and Innovation. It offers 3 resource(s) in shp, tab, fgdb, kmz, gpkg, xml. The portal shows 2025-05-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
